verdict.rationale: Buzz supports creating channels/rooms with visibility settings (buzz channels create --visibility open, 'make it private') and repo protection controls, but evidence is thin on explicit team-admin membership management (invite/remove members, role-based permissions across public/private channels) beyond agent enrollment via keys; community critique also flags that the group/permission model is untested in real-world scenarios. missing for 10: documented admin UI/CLI for managing human member lists per channel, robust real-world validation of the permission model, and independent corroboration of private-channel access controls holding up in practice.
